prompt_text: Analyze Prompt668 operational use acceptance and propose the next bounded local-only prompt to increase operational run scale. Preserve all safety constraints: no remote push, no PR creation, no merge, no destructive cleanup, no credential/cookie/browser-profile/.env/private-session access, and no arbitrary free-text prompt execution. Focus on scaling from one small operational task to a bounded set of local-safe operational tasks with stronger evidence retention.
